   (sphere 1.1 x eyeball, smaller than the lids), thin shell lids around separate eyeballs (Keelan
   Jon's lids from the eyeball, amVAlpxHp8k 00:37:05), nose wings tucked in, ear bowls, neck
   muscles. Hair and costume as separate Clay objects (`to_object(name, symmetric=False)` for
   anything asymmetric). GATE: profile beats; eyes not marbles or bags; hair frames the face;
   `stage_report` clean.
3. **Secondary (H/130 to H/150, `remesh_stage`).** Lines with `crease_line` (mouth, under-lip, lid
   rim) on surfaces facing the projection; nostrils from below. Restate planes with `corner_cut` /
   `plane_cut` only where the mass is right and moves stay small. GATE: under 100k faces (Abbitt),
   no scratches, cracks or rims in 90 mm renders.
4. **Surface finish (client quality): live GUI.** Real Clay Strips, Scrape, Crease Polish, Smooth
   0.2 via `bx_gui` (fixed and verified: strokes raycast onto the mesh and pass object-space
   locations; `set_view(frame=obj)` first, `view_distance` a few head heights). Headless numpy
   strokes suit blockout and primary forms, not polish. Multires only on a settled clean base
   (Henning Cmi0KoFtc-4 00:16:04).
5. **Expression.** Neutral symmetric basis; `sc = S.Sculptor(head, symmetry_x=False)`,
   `move_feature` the corner, cheek, lower lid, opposite brow;
   `S.write_shape_key(head, "Smirk", sc.co)`. Size the corner move to the delivery framing
   (Numbers). Voxel remesh drops keys: last step.
6. **Final render.** `S.final_render(objs, path, direction, lens=90, res=1600)` (cavity, framed on
   real vertices) from front, profile, three-quarter, neutral and expression; open every image.

Inside every stage: render, name ONE weakest link, fix it, re-render (Yan). A metric that passes
while the render looks wrong means the render wins.

## Numbers

| Value                   | Number                                                                                                                                                                                                           | Source                          |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------- |
| Voxel ladder            | H/40 blockout, H/65 to H/110 primary, H/130 to H/235 secondary, about H/330 detail                                                                                                                               | Morren, Abbitt; example         |
| Faces from voxel        | about 1.5 x area / voxel^2 (`voxel_for_faces`)                                                                                                                                                                   | measured, 3 %                   |
| Example bust faces      | H/40 8k, H/110 64k, H/150 103k (with neck)                                                                                                                                                                       | measured                        |
| Face gates              | shape before 100k; detail about 500k                                                                                                                                                                             | Abbitt                          |
| Raw remesh mirror error | max 0.67 to 0.75 voxel, mean 0.05 to 0.07 voxel (nearest vertex)                                                                                                                                                 | measured                        |
| Clay blends (head)      | masses 0.08 to 0.15 H, plane clips 0.02 to 0.03 H, lids 0.012 H                                                                                                                                                  | example [added]                 |
| Jaw                     | bigonial 0.90 to 1.00 x bizygomatic (example 0.93); ramus-to-base angle 124 degrees in the example                                                                                                               | Thelen; example [added]         |
| Eyes (stylized)         | radius 0.064 H, lids 0.012 H thick, upper margin 21 degrees above center                                                                                                                                         | example; 14 degrees read sleepy |
| Hair                    | clumps 0.065 to 0.115 H radius, rising 0.8 x radius, from the hairline back; base 0.008 to 0.02 H                                                                                                                | example [added]                 |
| Corner move that reads  | about 1/8 of mouth width (8 mm on 65 mm, 0.03 H); invisible at 1/30                                                                                                                                              | measured                        |
| Pixels per mm           | bust fills 1080 px: 2.8; bust 270 px tall: 0.75                                                                                                                                                                  | measured (`framing`)            |
| Smooth strength         | 0.2 (5.2 default 0.7)                                                                                                                                                                                            | Henning                         |
| Crease resolution       | at least 3 to 4 vertices across the radius                                                                                                                                                                       | Ryan King                       |
| Review lens             | 85 to 95 mm perspective                                                                                                                                                                                          | Morren, Kaspar, Naydenov, Yan   |
| Landmarks               | eye line 0.5 H; nose bottom halfway brow to chin; lip parting 1/3 nose to chin; ear nose base to brow; width H/1.5; mouth corners under eye centers; canthal tilt about 8 degrees; neck about 15 degrees forward | Abbitt, Naydenov, Thelen        |

## Quality gates

- **Measurable:** `S.stage_report(obj, voxel)` (components 1, non_manifold 0, stretch p95/median
  under 2.5, mirror_max under 1e-4 before asymmetry). `S.lower_face_report(head, H)`: `ball` True
  means the lower face fits one sphere within 10 % and twice as well as a plane (calibrated: the
  three E2 balloon jaws 0.057 to 0.082, the baseline 0.18 to 0.20, the v2 example 0.23 to 0.26).
  `S.profile_rhythm(obj)`: chin out, in, lips out, in, nose out (a nose hanging below the nose base
  hides the lip beats). `sc.planarity(c, r)` for a stated plane.
- **Visual (the gate):** `S.long_lens_render` or `final_render` at 85 to 95 mm from front, profile,
  three-quarter and below, plus `bx_review.review(..., modes=("silhouette", "matcap"))` for the
  ortho silhouette. Order: silhouette, big planes (cavity off, or `mode="flat"`), below and above,
  lines, character read at thumbnail size. Rubric:
  [`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md).

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                       | What it looks like                                       | Fix                                                                                                                                           |
| --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| rounded_box or ellipsoid jaw, heavy smoothing | balloon lower face: cheek, jaw, jowl one sphere          | Clay jaw block with stated planes; `lower_face_report` gate                                                                                   |
| Flatten or scrape dabs to "make planes"       | facets that follow the ball                              | stated planes: Clay clips, `plane_cut`, `corner_cut`                                                                                          |
| Plane cuts on a wrong mass                    | gem facet with a rim, metric passes                      | move or rebuild the mass first, then cut                                                                                                      |
| Jaw block with its front ahead of the mouth   | a mask or slab over the lower face                       | jaw behind the mound; front belongs to mound and chin                                                                                         |
| Tall jaw block, small blend                   | a panel edge across the cheek                            | low block, 0.15 H blend upward                                                                                                                |
| Socket wider than the lids                    | ring groove, eye bags                                    | socket 1.1 x eyeball, lid blend 0.012 H                                                                                                       |
| Lids reaching behind the eye equator          | sealed pocket, 3 components                              | clip lids at the eye center plane                                                                                                             |
| Uniform hair offset, or clumps on a thick cap | helmet ledge, beanie with worms                          | thin base, clumps make the volume                                                                                                             |
| Clumps starting behind the hairline           | bare headband over the forehead                          | start clumps at the hairline                                                                                                                  |
| Symmetrizing asymmetric parts                 | swept hair mirrored, center seam                         | `to_object(..., symmetric=False)`                                                                                                             |
| Crease projected across a grazing surface     | parallel cracks                                          | crease only surfaces facing the view; skip it                                                                                                 |
| Smile sculpted into the basis                 | asymmetry cannot be removed                              | neutral basis, `write_shape_key`                                                                                                              |
| Corner moved 1 to 2 mm                        | expression invisible                                     | about 1/8 of mouth width, check pixels                                                                                                        |
| No hair or costume                            | bald mannequin                                           | cue list in stage 0                                                                                                                           |
| Detail before proportions                     | lines on a wrong skull                                   | stay coarse until the gates pass                                                                                                              |
| Stroke snapped with nearest from far away     | groove on the nose tip                                   | `on_surface(p, view)`                                                                                                                         |
| Mask survived the remesh                      | a region refuses every brush                             | `remesh_stage` clears it                                                                                                                      |
| GUI strokes with the view zoomed out          | whole mesh flattened                                     | `bx_gui.set_view(frame=obj)`, check `view_distance`                                                                                           |
| Hairline as one tilted cut                    | a garrison cap from the side, vertical wall at the front | hairline as a function of azimuth (sideburn, over the ear, down to the nape), quiff ramp from the hairline over about 0.12 H [eval]           |
| Mirrored eyes                                 | no gaze, a staring or blank attitude                     | two aimed eyeballs; lid margin and brow angle are attitude dials (level brows for a neutral basis) [eval]                                     |
| Feature attached at two points                | a nose that floats in profile, see-through gaps          | ray-grid silhouette-hole probe per view; give a big nose a side wall to the cheek; `bx_audit` self-intersections after the last remesh [eval] |

## Blender 5.2 notes

- Headless CRASH (segfault): `sculpt.symmetrize`, `sculpt.mesh_filter`, `paint.mask_flood_fill`,
  `sculpt.mask_filter`, `sculpt.face_sets_create`, `sculpt.face_sets_init`, `object.voxel_remesh` in
  Sculpt Mode. Poll fails: `sculpt.brush_stroke`, `sculpt.set_pivot_position`,
  `sculpt.detail_flood_fill`, trim gestures. Work: `paint_mask_extract`, `brush.asset_activate`,
  Edit Mode `mesh.symmetrize`, `quadriflow_remesh`, multires ops.
- OpenVDB ships with Blender 5.2 (`import openvdb`): `FloatGrid.copyFromArray` + `convertToQuads`
  mesh the Clay.
- Brushes are Essentials assets; Flatten, Fill, Scrape are one Plane type; `size` is a diameter;
  Draw Sharp defaults to SUBTRACT. `sculpt_tool` is `sculpt_brush_type`.
- Voxel remesh output is flat shaded (`shade_smooth()`), keeps attributes (mask included), drops
  shape keys.
- NumPy 2 in Blender: `np.ptp(a)`, not `a.ptp()`.

## References

- [`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md): tested code for every stage (Clay recipe,
  planes, form check, hair, lids, expression, final render, crash matrix, brush table, GUI recipe);
  load before writing any sculpt script.
- [`references/expert-notes.md`](references/expert-notes.md): principles by expert with timestamps;
  load when designing a character or choosing methods.
- `references/critique.md`: stage rubric with blockers; load at every gate.
- [`references/sources.md`](references/sources.md): the 27 source videos with best timestamps.
- Example: `tests/code/blender-sculpting/stylized_head_blockout.py` (13 s, renders in
  `stylized_head/stage_N/`); comparison: `tests/code/blender-sculpting/compare/compare_sheet.png`.

skills.name: gh-sc-scenario-blender-uv-baking
skills.description: Use when UV unwrapping, placing seams, straightening or packing UVs, setting texel density, laying out UDIMs or mirrored UVs, or baking normal, AO, curvature, ID or displacement maps from a sculpt or high poly onto a low poly or retopo in Blender, including Multires bakes. Also when a bake has black or inverted patches, flat areas, cracks, seams, wavy lines or AO ghosts, bpy.ops.object.bake returns CANCELED, or uv.unwrap silently fails.
skills.body:
# UV unwrapping and baking

Expert-level UVs put seams where the texturing method can afford them, set texel density before
texture size, and pack with pixel-true padding. Expert bakes measure their projection distances
instead of guessing, and are judged in pixels and under a raking light, never eyeballed once. Every
stage below has a measurable gate that [`scripts/bx_uvbake.py`](scripts/bx_uvbake.py) computes. If a
sibling skill named here is missing from your available skills, load it with `skill_get` (Scenario
MCP) or ask the user to install it (https://github.com/scenario-labs/skills#install); unattended,
proceed from tool schemas and flag the gap.

**REQUIRED BACKGROUND:** scenario-blender-expert (execution channel, review loop, 5.2 API changes).

## Stance (the expert delta)

- **Seams follow the texturing method.** Kaspar (2021, 2D painting): as few as possible, hidden
  under hair, clothes and inner limbs. Blender Studio guide (2024, same author): more seams rather
  than fewer when you paint in 3D or bake, because stretch costs more. Game bakes add a hard rule:
  every hard edge is a seam, or the normal map cracks (Lampel, Gambrell, On Mars 3D, Polycount).
- **Only closed shells and long tubes need extra cuts.** Morren: anything closed on itself needs one
  cut. Gambrell: cut every taped-paper ring once, hidden. But an island with holes (a face with eye
  holes, a washer) flattens fine. `cut_to_disks` test-unwraps it and cuts only if it stretches
  [added; cutting everything folded the sheep's big islands].
- **Unwrap method is a measurement, and 5.2 defaults to CONFORMAL.** Always pass `method=`. On
  Suzanne, Minimum Stretch gives the most even density (spread 1.38), Angle Based the best angles,
  and Conformal fails by area (5.89). On flat hard-surface islands all three converge.
  `unwrap(method="BEST")` picks per island and rejects islands that fold over themselves.
- **Density first, texture size second** (Huge Menace). Targets: FPS 10.24 px/cm, weapon 20.48,
  third person 5.12, top-down 2.56. Priority follows the camera: face, hands and front up; soles,
  inner mouth and back down (SpeedChar, Kaspar). Match texture sets by scaling the denser set down,
  never the other up (Gambrell).
- **Straighten, then equalize, then pack without tilting** (Lampel): Follow Active Quads from a
  truly rectangular quad, pin, re-unwrap the rest, pack with CARDINAL. Padding is a pixel number,
  res/128 (16 px at 2K), passed as FRACTION margin = gap/(2*res).
- **Measure the projection, never guess extrusion, and do not trust one global value.** Ryan King's
  0.01 then 0.02 was scene-specific. SpeedChar swept six values by hand, and the value that fixed
  the face broke the armpit ("when we fix something somewhere, some other problems occur",
  E6QMhGuhyoc [00:26:23]). Rays start on the low, and `max_ray_distance` counts from the extruded
  start. The adaptive bake keeps, per texel, the smallest extrusion that hits a front face. On the
  sheep it cut inverted texels from 7.5% to 1.2% [verified].
- **Unique UVs wherever baked lighting differs** (SpeedChar: an AO ghost means shared texels).
  Stacked or mirrored copies move exactly one tile out of 0-1 before the bake (Polycount), because
  inside 0-1 the last island baked wins.
- **A bake is judged in pixels and under light.** Blue < 0.5 means rays hit the far side. Exactly
  flat means rays missed. All-white AO means the distance is too small. Inverted pixels that do not
  move when extrusion changes point to a geometry problem, not a setting [verified on the sheep].
  Multires bakes cast no rays: on the same surface they gave 0.09% inverted texels.

## Establish first

| Input             | Changes                                      | Default when the brief is silent                         |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| Target            | seams, symmetry, UDIM vs sets, triangulation | game engine, one 0-1 set per material                    |
| Texturing method  | seam count and visibility                    | 3D painting/Substance: seams may show at the back        |
| Camera            | density and priorities                       | third person 512 px/m, closest view defines tiles        |
| Texture budget    | resolution, sets, UDIM count                 | 2048 per set; `texture_size_for` decides                 |
| Deformation       | seams off joints, tangent-space normals      | character: tangent space, unique UVs                     |
| High source       | Selected to Active vs Multires               | separate sculpt: Selected to Active                      |
| Engine convention | normal green channel                         | OpenGL (Blender, Unity, glTF); `directx=True` for Unreal |

## Workflow

1. **Pre-flight.** Apply scale (On Mars 3D: it "fixes the vast majority" of problems). Clear
   non-manifold geometry, doubles and back faces (SpeedChar). Decide on Mirror and Solidify
   modifiers. If UVs exist, compare `island_topology` with `uv_qa` islands: seam flags in files are
   often leftover retopology marks, so run `seams_from_uv_islands` (Lampel) before re-unwrapping.
   GATE: scale 1, `bx_audit` clean, topology table read.
2. **Seams.** Hard surface: `seams_from_sharp(obj, 30, mark_sharp=True)`. Organic: build part labels
   (head, ears, limbs, torso front and back, soles, inner mouth and eyelids per the Kaspar and
   Morren seam maps in [`references/expert-notes.md`](references/expert-notes.md)), then
   `seams_from_groups(obj, labels)`. Specific cuts: `seam_path(obj, v_a, v_b, view_dirs)`. Then
   `cut_to_disks(obj, view_dirs=[camera])`. GATE: `must_cut` empty; a checker render shows no seams
   across hero areas that the brief cannot afford.
3. **Unwrap.** `unwrap(obj, method="BEST")`, or the method the island type calls for. GATE:
   `unsolved_faces` 0 (the operator returns FINISHED even when it fails), `folding_islands` empty
   (else `seams_from_groups(..., faces=folding_faces)` and unwrap again), angle p95 at most 15 to 20
   deg.
4. **Straighten** grid-like islands (hard surface, garments, strands): `straighten(obj)` before any
   scaling. GATE: straight stripes in the checker.
5. **Texel density.** `normalize_texel_density(obj, target, res, weights)`, then
   `texture_size_for(obj, target)`. GATE: island spread within 10-20%, or the intended priority
   ratios.
6. **Pack.** `pack(obj, tex_res=res)`, with `scale=False` for a strict density and `allow_any=True`
   for organic islands. UDIM: pack each region, then `move_to_tile`. GATE: `uv_qa`: 0 overlaps, gap
   at least res/128, border at least gap/2, coverage at least 0.70 or an explained exception.
7. **Look.** `uv_layout_image`, `checker_review`, `distortion_review(metric="angle")`. Judge with
   [`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md).
8. **Bake prep.** `prepare_low(low, triangulate=game, sharp_from_uv_islands=hard_surface)`. Check
   the silhouette against the high (`bx_audit.audit(low, high=...)`). Explode interpenetrating or
   moving parts (`explode`, one axis). Run `measure_projection`: `miss_pct` under 2 and
   `wrong_part_pct` under 1, else use a cage, explode, or bake per pair.
9. **Bake.** `bake_high_to_low(low, highs, out, res=512)` first, then the final resolution. It uses
   adaptive extrusion by default and hides every other object from render. Multires:
   `bake_multires`. Extras: `bake_id`, `curvature_from_normal`. GATE: `sanity[...]["problems"]`
   empty (inverted texels under 2%, notes from 0.2%), 16-bit PNG. If inverted texels remain, run
   `map_problem_review` to see where. If `sweep_projection` shows they do not move with extrusion,
   fix the geometry (fit, holes, thin parts), not the numbers.
10. **Review and hook up.** `bake_review(low, highs, paths, out)`: the low with maps must read like
    the high under the raking light. Then `hookup_maps`. Report measured numbers and what was not
    verified.

## Numbers

| Value                                                                                  | Relative to                                      | Source                                        |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------- |
| 10.24 / 20.48 / 5.12 / 2.56 px/cm                                                      | FPS world / FPS weapon / third person / top-down | Huge Menace [00:12:28]                        |
| 10-20% density mismatch invisible                                                      | between islands or sets                          | Gambrell [01:36:16]                           |
| coverage above 70%, 75% studio minimum                                                 | one 0-1 tile                                     | Gambrell [01:31:56], Huge Menace [00:16:27]   |
| island gap res/128 (8/16/32 px at 1K/2K/4K)                                            | texture resolution                               | Lampel [00:38:01], On Mars 3D [00:11:18]      |
| FRACTION margin m: gap 2m, border m                                                    | Blender pack                                     | verified                                      |
| bake margin res/128, 16 px at 2K                                                       | texture resolution                               | On Mars 3D, digest                            |
| cylinder sides: 6 min, 8 recommended                                                   | low poly silhouette                              | On Mars 3D [00:03:48]                         |
| samples: 16 for normals, 128 for AO, 1 only while iterating                            | antialiasing and noise                           | Gambrell/Marmoset 16, SpeedChar 4x4, verified |
| test bake 512, final 2048                                                              | iteration loop                                   | SpeedChar [00:59:09]                          |
| AO distance about 0.2 x bbox diagonal (default 10 units)                               | asset size                                       | [added], verified effect                      |
| angle error p95 at most 15 deg organic, 3 deg flat                                     | per corner                                       | [added] from 5.2.1 measurements               |
| Blender packer on an organic character: 55-62%                                         | 16 px gap at 2K                                  | measured on the sheep (several runs)          |
| inverted texels: single pass 7.3-7.8%, adaptive 2.2% (sculpt) / 1.2% (consistent high) | selected to active, sheep                        | measured                                      |
| 2048 bake, 186k-face high: one pass normal + AO 4.4 s, adaptive 25 s                   | Metal GPU, headless                              | measured                                      |

## Quality gates

Code: `q = uv_qa(obj, res)`, then `uv_verdict(q, "game" or "film", priorities=...)`.
`unwrap()["unsolved_faces"]` and `["folding_islands"]`. `measure_projection()`.
`bake_high_to_low()["sanity"]` (inverted, exact-flat, non-unit, AO black and white). Cross-check
overlaps with `bpy.ops.uv.select_overlap()` when in doubt; it agreed with the raster on the tests.

Visual: layout PNG (islands, magenta overlaps), color-grid checker from front, side, three-quarter
and the production camera (squares square, letters upright, seams hidden), angle and density heat
maps, `bake_review` sheet (high, low, low + maps), `map_problem_review` when sanity flags pixels.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                                    | Looks like                                  | Fix                                                                |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `uv.unwrap()` without `method`                             | Conformal area distortion                   | pass `method=` or use `unwrap(method="BEST")`                      |
| Trusting FINISHED                                          | closed island keeps its old UVs, repacked   | zero the UVs first, check for zero-area faces (`unwrap()` does it) |
| Re-unwrapping without Seams from Islands                   | layout lost; retopology marks used as seams | `seams_from_uv_islands` first                                      |
| Cutting every island to a disk                             | slits, folded islands                       | measured `cut_to_disks` (default)                                  |
| Pack rotation ANY after straightening                      | tilted grids, jaggy lines                   | CARDINAL                                                           |
| Blender margin 0.005                                       | padding depends on island scale             | FRACTION, gap/(2*res)                                              |
| Target node active but not selected                        | bake returns CANCELED, no error             | select and activate; assert FINISHED                               |
| Low carries the sculpt as Multires                         | almost flat normal map                      | render levels 0 for the bake (bake_high_to_low does it)            |
| max_ray shorter than extrusion                             | 90% exactly flat map                        | ray = extrusion + inward depth                                     |
| One global extrusion on thin, close parts (ears on a head) | inverted patches, neighbors baked in        | adaptive bake (default), explode, or per-pair bakes                |
| Other objects render-visible during AO                     | black AO                                    | hide them from render; the active low never occludes               |
| Default AO distance 10                                     | AO all dark or flat                         | about 0.2 x asset diagonal                                         |
| Stacked UVs baked in 0-1                                   | one side's detail on both                   | unique UVs or `offset_stacked`                                     |
| Hard edge inside an island                                 | crack lines                                 | seam it, or `prepare_low(sharp_from_uv_islands=True)`              |
| Editing UVs after the bake                                 | seams, tangent mismatch                     | never; re-bake                                                     |

## Blender 5.2 notes

- `uv.unwrap` defaults to CONFORMAL. On failure it keeps the island's old UVs and repacks them. It
  has `use_weights`/`weight_group` (default group "uv_importance"): importance weights with Minimum
  Stretch. A weighted top half went from 31% to 74% of UV area [verified].
- Sync select is on by default (5.0). `BMLoopUV` only has `uv` and `pin_uv`. A `me.uv_layers[...]`
  reference goes stale after an Edit Mode toggle, so keep the name.
- `pack_islands(udim_source="CLOSEST_UDIM")` headless packed a region sitting in 1002 back into
  1001: pack first, then move. `uv.move_on_axis` needs a UV editor.
- Bake: the target must be selected AND active (5.0). Operator defaults differ from scene defaults
  (`use_clear` False vs True, EXTEND vs ADJACENT_FACES): pass everything. Selected to Active uses
  the low's render evaluation (Multires render_levels, shape keys). Multires settings live in
  `scene.render.bake.use_multires` with `object.bake_image()`. A float image saved as PNG is 16-bit.
  Normal Map node `convention` OPENGL/DIRECTX (5.1). UDIM tiles need `image.tile_add(fill=True)`.
- Auto Smooth is gone (4.1): smooth shading plus sharp edges; Triangulate "Keep Normals" is
  `keep_custom_normals`.

## References

- `references/expert-notes.md`: judgment by expert with timestamps, disagreements and deciding
  conditions, my 5.2.1 measurements. Load when choosing seams, density or a bake strategy.
- [`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md): tested pipelines (hard-surface, character,
  film/UDIM, Multires, bake-fix loop) and raw bpy snippets executed by the tests. Load before
  writing code.
- `references/critique.md`: rubric for seams, stretch, density, packing, bake setup and baked maps,
  with proxies and severity. Load at every gate.
- [`references/sources.md`](references/sources.md): videos, credentials, URLs, best timestamps, web
  references.
- `scripts/bx_uvbake.py`: the module (docstrings list every function).

skills.name: gh-sc-scenario-roblox-animation
skills.description: Use when animating Roblox characters, NPCs or creatures: animation not playing, wrong animation wins, animation priority or weight, blending, animation events and markers, hit timing, import from Blender or FBX, custom rig or creature rig, Motor6D or AnimationConstraint joints, procedural animation, IKControl look-at or foot and hand IK, FaceControls and dynamic head expressions, replacing the default Animate animations, KeyframeSequence or CurveAnimation built in code, Animator replication, AnimationController NPCs, Character Controller Library abilities, adaptive animation for custom humanoids.
skills.body:
# Roblox animation and characters

Target line: Roblox Studio (October 2026 build) on macOS, driven through the scenario-roblox-expert
toolkit.

Expert level here means every clip, layer, IK chain and face is proven in Studio by numbers: which
track wins each joint, when each marker fires, what the server sees, and that the stepped pose
matches its source. An agent cannot drive the Animation Editor, so it builds clips in code, steps
them in Edit, plays them in a playtest and measures joints and tracks before it calls anything done.
If a sibling skill named here is missing from your available skills, load it with `skill_get`
(Scenario MCP) or ask the user to install it (https://github.com/scenario-labs/skills#install);
unattended, proceed from tool schemas and flag the gap.

**REQUIRED BACKGROUND:** scenario-roblox-expert (channels, review loop, toolkit, current-Roblox
traps).

## Stance (the expert delta)

1. **Avatar joints are `AnimationConstraint`, not `Motor6D`.** The Avatar Joint Upgrade made R15
   `C0` and `C1` read-only (L1, L8). Procedural motion multiplies into `Transform` in PreSimulation,
   which applies as a deferred batch and does not replicate (Suphi Kaner, BRYp2-rdpXQ 00:00:33).
   Code that looks joints up must accept both classes.
2. **Load through the `Animator`, from the side that owns the rig.** The owning client plays its
   character's tracks and the server sees them (L6); the server plays NPC tracks and clients see
   them (L7). `Humanoid:LoadAnimation` is deprecated.
3. **Priority partitions joints; keys claim them.** A higher priority wins only the joints it keys,
   and an identity key still claims its joint (L4). In clips built in code, parent Poses that are
   only on the path need Weight 0, or they override lower tracks [added] (L4).
4. **Time gameplay with markers, never waits.** Use one event name with a parameter (Develuper,
   d5GGIJJyMpg 00:02:52). `GetMarkerReachedSignal` fired within one frame (L6); `KeyframeReached`
   needs named keyframes (BrawlDev, zSK7bOoxuig 00:25:25).
5. **Faces play as clips, not property writes.** On a player's dynamic head, a `FaceControls` write
   or a finished tween reverts to 0 within 0.5 s, even with every track stopped [added] (L10, L16).
   A face clip holds, replicates, and survives the mood animation.
6. **IKControls are created on the server; look-at weight is 0.999.** At weight 1 the neck twists
   when the target passes behind; `IKControl.Priority` orders the solves; `Pole` is set from code
   (Suphi Kaner, 8fV-XOOj6O4 00:18:56, 00:53:00, 00:54:40).
7. **Blender clips are 24 fps, armature only, no scale keys.** Leaf bones, NLA strips and All
   Actions go off; Force Start/End Keying and Simplify 0 stay on (Mykaiju, NI7GXKLwk6U 00:23:45 to
   00:27:07). 60 fps doubles the keys for no gain in gameplay (Nisky, EM9u4gIHoRg 00:07:55).
8. **Temporary ids are test fixtures.** `RegisterKeyframeSequence` hashes and `active://` ids work
   in Studio only; the shipped game references published `rbxassetid://` ids owned by the experience
   owner (Animation Editor docs).

## Establish first

- **Rig kind.** R15 avatar (AnimationConstraint, BallSocket limits), custom part rig (Motor6D),
  skinned mesh (Bones), or AnimationController creature. Run P1 instead of guessing.
- **Who plays what.** Player clips on the client, NPC clips on the server, cosmetic layers locally.
- **Server Authority.** When on, an Animator keeps at most 8 active tracks, and tracks are looked up
  each tick with `GetTrackByAnimationId`, never cached.
- **Character Controller Library.** When on, movement comes from `ControllerManager` and abilities;
  ability callbacks never yield.
- **Faces.** Is there a dynamic head (`Head` has `FaceControls`)?
- **Motion source.** Blender FBX, a Scenario-generated rig or motion, the Animation Editor, or code.
- **Publishing owner.** User or group; clips must be published under the experience owner.
- Defaults: R15, Action for gameplay clips, Idle and Movement for locomotion, 24 fps, markers named
  after the event with a parameter.

## Procedure

Code for every step is in `references/procedures.md` (P1 to P15), with the test that ran it and its
numbers.

1. **Inspect the rig (P1).** Run `AnimRig.joints`, `AnimRig.tree` and `AnimRig.path` on the model.
   GATE: joint classes are known, every animated part has a path from the root, and an Animator
   exists.
2. **Build or bring the clips (P2, P3, P10).** Code clips use `AnimClip.keyframes` or
   `AnimClip.curves`, are registered with `AnimClip.register` and loaded with `AnimClip.load`, which
   waits for `Length > 0`. Blender clips go through `blender_roblox_anim.py` (audit, export, sample)
   and `AnimClip.fromSamples`. GATE: stepped joint angles match the keys within 0.3 degrees; Blender
   bone tails match within 0.01 studs.
3. **Layer and time (P4).** Set priorities, weights and fades; key only the joints each clip owns;
   put markers on contact frames. GATE: `AnimClip.tracks(animator)` shows the intended winner per
   joint, and each marker fires once per cycle.
4. **Preview in Edit (P5).** Call `AnimClip.settle` first: a clip that ended on its own still blends
   into the next one (P3). `rbx_animation.pose_sheet` steps a track with `Animator:StepAnimations`,
   captures each time and builds one contact sheet. GATE: read the sheet; the frame differences are
   above zero; `AnimRig.reset` leaves no posed joint before the place is saved.
5. **Playtest (P6, P8).** Play player clips from the client and NPC clips from the server; read the
   joints on both sides. GATE: the server finds the client's track, both sides report the same joint
   angle, and a capture shows the pose.
6. **Layers, IK and faces (P9, P12, P7).** Procedural offsets go into `Transform` in PreSimulation
   and skip when `Animator.EvaluationThrottled` is true. IK comes from `AnimIK.reach` and
   `AnimIK.lookAt`; faces from `AnimFace.clip`. GATE: the measured neck yaw, IK gap and face values
   on the server, plus a capture each.
7. **Defaults and audit (P13, P14).** Replace default animations through the `Animate` values; run
   `AnimAudit.all`. GATE: no error or warning finding; after a state change the client plays the new
   clip, checked by `Length` and joint angle, not by id.
8. **Publish list.** List every clip to publish, its priority, loop and markers, and the owner.
   GATE: no temporary id in shipped code (`AnimAudit` rule `temp-animation-id`).

## Numbers

| Value                          | Number                                                                           | Relative to                      |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------- |
| Priority order                 | Core < Idle < Movement < Action < Action2 < Action3 < Action4                    | `Enum.AnimationPriority`         |
| Default Animate tracks         | idle at Core, mood at Idle                                                       | L6, player avatar                |
| Fade                           | `Play(0.4)` ramps weight 0.25 per 0.1 s                                          | L4                               |
| Same-priority blend            | weighted mean: 90 and 60 degrees give 75 at equal weights, 84 at 1 and 0.25      | L4                               |
| Action at weight 0.5 over Idle | 60 degrees between 90 and 30                                                     | L4                               |
| Marker at 0.25 s of playback   | fired at 266 ms, frame 16.3 ms                                                   | L6, speed 2                      |
| Stopped and Ended              | 500 and 816 ms for a 0.5 s playback                                              | L6                               |
| Natural end, then a new clip   | old pose blends in for 0.25 to 0.375 s (31.8 instead of 22.5 degrees at 0.25 s)  | L3                               |
| First load                     | Length 0 at `LoadAnimation`, 14 ms to load in Edit                               | L2                               |
| Neck layer of 45 degrees       | 41.9 degrees on the joint, head 45.5 degrees off the root                        | L8                               |
| IK reach                       | hand 0.20 to 0.23 studs from a reachable target within 0.1 s, same on the client | L9                               |
| IK limits                      | 4.17 studs from an unreachable target; 1.13 at Weight 0.5                        | L9                               |
| IK SmoothTime 0.5              | gap 1.81 to 0.37 studs over 0.6 s                                                | L9                               |
| Look-at                        | Weight 0.999; head within 0.05 degrees of the target                             | L9; Suphi Kaner                  |
| Face write or tween            | back to 0 within 0.5 s                                                           | L10                              |
| Face clip                      | JawDrop 0.55 on client and server; the open mouth shows in the capture           | L10                              |
| Blender to Studio              | worst bone-tail error 0.0002 studs, 10 bones, 25 frames                          | L12                              |
| Skin weights                   | at most 4 influences per vertex                                                  | skinning docs                    |
| Server Authority               | at most 8 active tracks per Animator                                             | Server Authority docs            |
| Dynamic head                   | 4,000 triangles; validation checks 5 animations from 17 FACS poses               | specs; Roblox Learn, OwhkWzSBnf0 |

## Quality gates

Measurable:

- `AnimAudit.all(game)` returns no error and no warning (P14).
- Every track the code plays reports `Length > 0`, the intended priority and `WeightCurrent` 1 at
  rest (`AnimClip.tracks`).
- Each marker the code listens to fires once per cycle at its time, within one frame.
- Server and client report the same joint angles for replicated tracks.
- Blender exports pass `audit` with no finding, and P10's tail error is under 0.01 studs.
- `AnimRig.dirty` is empty on every rig before the place is saved.

Visual (contact sheets of at most 1,600 px, `rbx_review.contact_sheet`):

- Pose sheet of each clip at 4 to 6 times: silhouettes read, arcs, no interpenetration, closed loop.
- Playtest captures: player clip, NPC clip, IK reach with the target visible, face close-up next to
  a neutral capture.
- Judge with `references/critique.md`.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                           | Symptom                                                                          | Fix                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Clip at Core or Idle                              | plays but the default idle wins                                                  | Action for gameplay clips                                                                 |
| Action clip keys the legs                         | legs freeze while walking                                                        | key only the joints the clip owns                                                         |
| Code-built clip with Weight 1 parents             | upper body overrides idle and walk                                               | Weight 0 on path-only Poses (`AnimClip.keyframes`)                                        |
| Playing right after a fresh register              | nothing moves, `Length` 0                                                        | `AnimClip.load` waits for `Length > 0`                                                    |
| `C0` writes on avatar joints                      | "Property is read only"                                                          | multiply into `Transform` in PreSimulation                                                |
| `FindFirstChildOfClass("Motor6D")` on R15         | nil on upgraded avatars                                                          | `AnimRig.joint` accepts both classes                                                      |
| Tweening `FaceControls`                           | expression flashes, then neutral                                                 | `AnimFace.clip` played on the Animator                                                    |
| `task.wait` for hit timing                        | hits drift with speed and lag                                                    | markers with parameters                                                                   |
| Preview left posed in Edit                        | saved place shows the pose                                                       | `AnimRig.reset(rig)`                                                                      |
| `rig.HumanoidRootPart` on a Custom skinned import | nil: the importer names the root `RootPart` (2 x 2 x 1), and bones never collide | `AnimRig.prepareImport`; clips authored before it still bind (`references/characters.md`) |
| Measuring right after another clip ended          | first 0.3 s blends toward the old end pose                                       | `AnimClip.settle` in Edit; deliberate fades in game                                       |
| Checking a replaced default by its id             | id matches while the old clip plays                                              | check `Length` and the joint after a state change                                         |
| 60 fps or scale keys in Blender                   | heavy clips, scale ignored                                                       | 24 fps, rotation and location only                                                        |
| LookAt Weight 1                                   | neck twists when the target is behind                                            | 0.999                                                                                     |
| Shipping a temporary id                           | works in Studio, fails live                                                      | publish under the experience owner                                                        |
| Animator created on a client for a shared rig     | others never see it                                                              | create it on the server                                                                   |

## Handoffs

- **Receives from scenario-roblox-assets:** imported rigs and skinned meshes, including rigged
  characters and motions generated by scenario-3d. Motions arrive as FBX or Blender files and go
  through P10; rigs arrive as Models that P1 inspects.
- **Delivers to scenario-roblox-gameplay:** clips with markers at contact frames and their
  parameters; gameplay owns the hitboxes, state and NPC behavior that call them.
- **Delivers to scenario-roblox-vfx-audio:** marker names and times for footsteps, impacts and
  trails.
- **Works with scenario-roblox-networking:** look direction replication, Server Authority track
  rules, client-only cosmetic layers.
- **Works with scenario-roblox-performance:** Animator counts, NPC culling (anchor and disable
  Animators out of range, RDC 2025 rwLEnBtXr30 00:09:24), `stepAnimation` cost.
- **Works with scenario-roblox-architecture:** where animation controllers live (client modules for
  player characters, server services for NPCs).
- **Asks the user** to publish the listed clips; agents never upload.

## Current Roblox notes

- Avatar Joint Upgrade: R15 avatars spawn with 15 AnimationConstraint joints and 14
  BallSocketConstraints (L1).
- `Workspace.AuthorityMode` is not readable from plugin-level Luau (RobloxScript capability): ask
  the user whether Server Authority is on.
- Character Controller Library is opt-in. With it off, `require("@rbx/AvatarAbilities")` never
  returns on the client and returns a table on the server (L15).
- Adaptive Animation: `HumanoidRigDescription:AutoRig` needs RobloxScript capability; joint mapping
  and T-pose are set in the Adaptive Animation tool (GUI). Mapping joints from code did not retarget
  a clip onto renamed parts (L14).
- `AnimationGraphDefinition` exists; graphs are edited in the Graph Editor (GUI).
- The Animation Editor opens from Avatar > Clip Editor in the current UI.

## References

- [`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md): P1 to P15 with full code, test ids and
  results.
- [`references/characters.md`](references/characters.md): Custom skinned import to a rig, player and
  NPC playback scripts, creature foot planting, dynamic head cages and validation, FBX import
  checks, character cost.
- [`references/expert-notes.md`](references/expert-notes.md): principles by expert, with timestamps.
- [`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md): the rubric for judging animation work.
- [`references/gui-paths.md`](references/gui-paths.md): Animation Editor, import, faces and beta
  toggles for a human or computer-use agent.
- [`references/sources.md`](references/sources.md): every source with credentials and timestamps.
- [`scripts/rbx_animation.py`](scripts/rbx_animation.py): kit inlining, Blender wrapper, sample
  loader, Edit pose sheets.
- [`scripts/blender_roblox_anim.py`](scripts/blender_roblox_anim.py): headless Blender test rig,
  audit, FBX export, re-import and samples.
- [`scripts/agentkit/animation/`](scripts/agentkit/animation/): AnimRig, AnimClip, AnimAudit, AnimIK
  and AnimFace Luau modules.

skills.name: gh-sc-scenario-roblox-environment
skills.description: Use when building or lighting a Roblox map: graybox or blockout, level layout, landmarks, doors and walls, parts versus unions (CSG), collision fidelity, terrain (generate, sculpt, paint, water, Part to Terrain), MaterialVariants, custom terrain materials, PBR textures from Scenario, skyboxes, Lighting, Atmosphere, Clouds, bloom, color correction, day or night moods, interior light, scattering rocks, bushes and trees, level of detail (SLIM, RenderFidelity), per-model streaming or a streaming test, collision overlays, invisible walls, or texture sizes. Also when a map looks flat, foggy, too dark or plastic, grass pokes through floors, a doorway blocks players, content pops in or never unloads, a custom material disappears, or the sun lights the wrong side.
skills.body:
# Roblox environment (builder, environment artist and lighter)

Target: Roblox Studio (October 2026 build) on macOS, driven through the scenario-roblox-expert
toolkit.

Expert environment work on Roblox means a graybox built from plain parts and composed from the spawn
camera, terrain and materials made from code with their silent failures checked, and light designed
from a mood with the sun aimed first and post effects last. This skill carries those rules from the
sources, corrected by live tests in Studio 0.743 on a village, terrain and interior built for the
purpose, plus kit modules that build, light, measure and audit a scene. If a sibling skill named
here is missing from your available skills, load it with `skill_get` (Scenario MCP) or ask the user
to install it (https://github.com/scenario-labs/skills#install); unattended, proceed from tool
schemas and flag the gap.

**REQUIRED BACKGROUND:** scenario-roblox-expert (channels, review loop, toolkit, current-Roblox
traps).

**Status (2026-10-19):** live run 2026-10-19 01:14 passed 14 of 14 in Studio 0.743; offline O1 to O9
pass. Scatter, the streaming test and the overlays are offline-tested only. A later run stalled on a
viewport that stopped drawing (see `references/procedures.md`).

## Stance (the expert delta)

1. **Graybox in plain parts, composed from the spawn camera.** Primitives, one grid MaterialVariant,
   folders with underscores, a ground color distinct from walls (Jalapeno, T--CNfkfBBQ [00:02:01 to
   00:02:35, 00:08:13]). Landmarks as loud placeholders at true size (RoBuilder, eRnnjqVOq7c
   [00:05:20]). Doorways and halls at least 10 studs wide, walls at least 10 tall (Roblox graybox
   tutorial). Compose from where players spawn and time the walk between landmarks (Gino,
   vWx8UTxsi0A [00:11:49, 00:12:21]).
   - Live: the template SpawnLocation faced away from the village, so the first view was a hillside.
     Turn the spawn toward the first landmark.
2. **Parts before CSG; test what collision does to openings.** Cut axis-aligned holes with parts,
   not unions (Kaiwala, x9jg8kjH3Vs [00:04:41]). Each distinct union is its own mesh and collision
   asset (Kaiwala, Ahn2P_4TDrU [00:20:40]). Pick fidelity by whether players pass through or touch
   the shape (Roblox collisions docs).
   - Kaiwala saw Default collision close a hole and switches to PreciseConvexDecomposition; Hull or
     Box are his cheap fix for simple shapes (Ahn2P_4TDrU [00:01:54, 00:02:28]).
   - Live: Hull and Box filled a 10 by 10 doorway; Default and PreciseConvexDecomposition kept it
     open. Probe every opening rather than trusting a fidelity name.
   - `GetPartBoundsInBox` reported every union door as blocked because it compares bounding boxes.
     Test passage with `GetPartsInPart` or a ray.
3. **Terrain from code, checked by reading the voxels.** Block out with parts, convert, then smooth
   (BONES, -DoOf32pkPo [00:04:34, 00:09:57]). Region calls need resolution 4, grid-aligned regions
   and at most 4,194,304 voxels each (Terrain reference).
   - Live: a `FillBlock` whose top sat at y 0 left the walkable surface near y 2.
     `TerrainKit.occupancy` places the surface exactly.
   - Live: a raycast right after a fill returned nothing. `TerrainKit.surfaceY` reads the height
     from the voxels instead.
   - Grass blades poke through parts; paint LeafyGrass there (SmartyRBX, CippiATeZ54 [00:01:40]).
     Live, they grew through every floor set on Grass; `TerrainKit.paintUnder` repaints under
     floors.
4. **Materials link by name, per base material, and terrain needs more.** A rename breaks every part
   using the variant (Roblox materials docs). Terrain uses a variant only through an override, one
   per material: Grass and LeafyGrass separately (SmartyRBX, CippiATeZ54 [00:05:13, 00:05:47]).
   - Live: creating a Basalt variant changed nothing until `SetBaseMaterialOverride`.
   - Live: the override still rendered near black because the terrain material color (Basalt 30,
     30, 37) multiplies the map. Brighten it with `Terrain:SetMaterialColor`, as SmartyRBX does by
     hand [00:02:44].
5. **Decide the mood, then aim the sun, then color.** Mood sentence first, ClockTime next
   (RingWorld, UlvSrWHESwA [00:01:06, 00:01:58]). Aim the sun so light lands where it matters
   (DatBoiEle, aq0Fi0R2FAY [00:02:11]; BONES uses GeographicLatitude as the direction control,
   zAoY8pxJM9c [00:08:36]).
   - Live: at the default latitude the spawn camera faced the sun and saw only shadow sides, tinted
     by Ambient. `Looks.aimSun` finds a ClockTime and GeographicLatitude for any direction, error
     under 1 degree.
6. **Warm light, cool shadow; contrast last, in small steps.** Ambient tints shadows and
   ColorShift_Top tints light; lowering EnvironmentDiffuseScale raises contrast (DatBoiEle
   [00:03:38, 00:05:48]). Realistic first; Atmosphere Density 0.3 to 0.4 with Offset 0; color
   correction last, for contrast (Develuper, vkEXLmRAQgs [00:00:27, 00:01:04, 00:02:16]). Move
   ColorCorrection in 0.05 steps (DatBoiEle [00:08:09]). His Bloom: Threshold about 0.03, a large
   Size, then Intensity lowered to taste [00:07:37].
7. **Night needs a focal light and silhouettes.** BONES' dark recipe works in a corridor: black
   Atmosphere Color and Decay, Density 0.495, Offset 0.25, Haze 5, Glare 0, environment scales 0,
   ExposureCompensation -0.4 (zAoY8pxJM9c [00:03:15 to 00:06:04]). Outdoors, RingWorld lowers
   Brightness, drops glare, tints blue and adds near and far lights (UlvSrWHESwA [00:06:44 to
   00:07:54]).
   - Deciding condition: does the player need the skyline? Live, the corridor recipe turned 96 to
     100 % of the far views black. `night_outdoor` kept every view readable.
8. **Interiors: windows must pass light, then fake the bounce.** Glass casting shadows blocks the
   sun shaft; turn CastShadow off (DatBoiEle [00:09:16]). For window-lit rooms BONES uses Brightness
   44, black ambients, environment scales 0. He adds a PointLight [234, 255, 254], Range 50, Shadows
   on, near the window (zAoY8pxJM9c [00:06:14, 00:07:14]). All three confirmed live.

## Establish first

- Camera and genre: third person (the default) needs larger doors and ceilings than first person.
- Target devices; mobile reach favors Soft lighting and the performance owner's budgets.
- Map size, StreamingEnabled, and which models must always exist on clients.
- One mood sentence per zone and two or three reference images.
- Asset sources: Scenario meshes, textures and skyboxes, or Roblox materials only.
- File pipeline: Rojo or Studio only. Several settings are file-only (Current Roblox notes).

Defaults: Realistic with PrioritizeLightingQuality, graybox grid variant at StudsPerTile 8, doors 10
by 10, the `day_fantasy` look aimed for the spawn view.

## Procedure

Setup: `import rbx_environment as E`, then
`E.run(studio, code, kit=["Graybox", "TerrainKit", "MaterialKit", "Looks", "EnvAudit"])` (it finds
the lead toolkit). Full code and recorded results:
[`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md).

1. **Readiness (P1).** Read LightingStyle, overrides and the file-only settings. **GATE:** values as
   intended; anything scripts refuse is set in the place file or the Properties panel.
2. **Graybox (P3).** `Graybox.house`, `wall`, `lantern`, `block` under `map_geo/<area>/<kind>`;
   landmark placeholders; spawn turned toward the first landmark. **GATE:** `Graybox.clearance`
   returns no findings; walk times reported; the spawn capture shows the landmark.
3. **Terrain (P2, P13, P4).** `TerrainKit.heightfield` with a height function, `water`, `fromParts`
   and `smooth`, then `paintUnder` for floors. **GATE:** the spawn ground (`groundY` after a frame,
   or `surfaceY`) sits at the design height; no grass through floors in the spawn and interior
   captures.
4. **Openings and collision (P5).** Openings from parts; any union keeps Default fidelity and the
   `Opening` attribute. **GATE:** a character-sized `GetPartsInPart` probe and a ray pass every
   doorway.
5. **Materials (P6).** `MaterialKit.kit`, `dress` by role, one override per terrain material,
   terrain material colors. **GATE:** `MaterialKit.links` returns 0 broken; each override reads
   back; the dressed captures judged with [`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md).
   - Foliage, rocks and trees: `Scatter.plan` and `Scatter.place`, with collision and LevelOfDetail
     per variant ([`references/foliage.md`](references/foliage.md)).
6. **Light (P7 to P10).** Snapshot, `Looks.apply`, `Looks.aimSun`, capture the same cameras before
   and after, `E.look_metrics`, one contact sheet. **GATE:** metric bands in Quality gates; the
   sheet judged against the mood sentence.
7. **Playtest (P11).** Client Stats, per-model streaming check, walk through a door. **GATE:** the
   character arrives inside; numbers go to the performance owner.
   - Checks that can fail beyond captures: streaming at radius 64, collision and invisible-blocker
     overlays, texture sizes and mesh groups
     ([`references/verification.md`](references/verification.md)).
8. **Audit and hand off (P12).** `EnvAudit.all(game)` in Studio, `E.lune_audit(place)` on the saved
   file. **GATE:** no error or warn.

## Numbers

| Value                               | Number                                                                                                    | Source                                     |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| Doorway and hall width; wall height | 10 studs at least                                                                                         | graybox tutorial                           |
| Default WalkSpeed; JumpHeight       | 16 studs/s; 7.2 (the tutorial's 5 is stale)                                                               | Humanoid reference                         |
| One stud                            | about 28 cm; imports are not converted                                                                    | units guide                                |
| Grid variant tile                   | StudsPerTile 8                                                                                            | Jalapeno                                   |
| Terrain region calls                | resolution 4, 4,194,304 voxels                                                                            | Terrain reference                          |
| CSG result                          | 20,000 triangles at most                                                                                  | solid modeling docs                        |
| Light Range                         | clamped to 120 on write (live)                                                                            | deltas                                     |
| Atmosphere Density, Offset (day)    | 0.3 to 0.4, 0                                                                                             | Develuper                                  |
| Dark Atmosphere                     | Density 0.495, Offset 0.25, Haze 5, Glare 0                                                               | BONES                                      |
| ExposureCompensation                | -0.4, move by decimals                                                                                    | BONES                                      |
| Window-lit interior                 | Brightness 44; fake GI [234, 255, 254], Range 50                                                          | BONES                                      |
| ColorCorrection steps               | 0.05; Contrast 0.1                                                                                        | DatBoiEle                                  |
| Streaming baseline                  | MinRadius 64, TargetRadius 1024, PauseOutsideLoadedArea, Opportunistic, Improved                          | streaming docs                             |
| Per-view budget on 2 GB phones      | 500 draw calls, 500k triangles                                                                            | McNeill, cWDNVvOh4o0 (performance owns it) |
| Script clamps (live)                | Atmosphere Glare and Haze 10, Density and Offset 1, ShadowSoftness 1; Brightness and Bloom Size unclamped | Studio 0.743                               |

## Quality gates

Measured (lower half of each capture with `skip_top=0.45`, so the sky does not dominate):

- Day looks: `crushed` under 0.05 in every view; spread wider than the neutral capture.
- Outdoor night: `crushed` under 0.5 in every view; a lit focal point near spawn.
- Interior with sun: the floor patch clips (`clipped` above 0.05) and the fake bounce lifts
  `mean_luma` while the patch stays.
- `Graybox.clearance`, `MaterialKit.links`, `EnvAudit`: zero findings at error or warn.
- Playtest: 60 fps on the dev machine; draw calls and triangles reported per view.

Judged by eye on the contact sheet ([`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md)): mood
matches the sentence; value structure reads in gray; light faces seen from spawn; landmark contrasts
with its background; no plastic or near-black materials; distance haze leaves silhouettes.

## Common mistakes

| Mistake                                                        | Fix                                                                                                                       |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Lighting.Technology = Future` in a script                     | `LightingStyle` plus `PrioritizeLightingQuality`; write `Technology` only in the place file                               |
| Streaming radii or `Terrain.Decoration` set by script          | file-only: Rojo `$properties` or Properties panel (live: "not a valid member")                                            |
| `LevelOfDetail = StreamingMesh` with a small radius            | SLIM for static models; StreamingMesh only with TargetRadius 1000 or more (Andrew, Wwj8EkMWFhI)                           |
| 4 by 8 doors                                                   | 10 by 10 at least                                                                                                         |
| A union door with Hull or Box                                  | parts, or a union with Default fidelity                                                                                   |
| A variant with BaseMaterial Grass, expecting terrain to change | `SetBaseMaterialOverride` for Grass and LeafyGrass, then check the terrain material color                                 |
| Renaming a variant after applying it                           | keep names; audit with `MaterialKit.links`                                                                                |
| ShadowSoftness tuned under Soft, then judged in Realistic      | judge in the style you ship; captures per style                                                                           |
| Tuning colors before the sun is aimed                          | `Looks.aimSun` first                                                                                                      |
| Judging bloom in an Edit capture                               | Bloom at Intensity 3 changed a capture no more than two identical captures differ (live); judge it in play or on a device |
| One far point light                                            | two lights, near and far; Range stops at 120                                                                              |
| Glass with CastShadow on                                       | CastShadow off                                                                                                            |

## Handoffs

| To or from                               | What                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| scenario-3d, then scenario-roblox-assets | Scenario meshes are imported and checked there (triangles, collision, SurfaceAppearance); this skill places them, sets fidelity and LevelOfDetail, and lights them            |
| scenario-textures                        | tileable PBR sets become MaterialVariants here (color, normal, roughness, metalness; OpenGL normals); one-mesh texture sets go to scenario-roblox-assets as SurfaceAppearance |
| scenario-skyboxes                        | six faces into `Sky.SkyboxBk/Dn/Ft/Lf/Rt/Up`; uploading needs the user's go; judge the sky with the look, since it colors the scene                                           |
| scenario-game-assets                     | decals and signage placed on surfaces here; UI art goes to scenario-roblox-ui                                                                                                 |
| scenario-roblox-performance              | streaming settings, budgets and device tests: send the P11 Stats and the EnvAudit counts                                                                                      |
| scenario-roblox-vfx-audio                | particles, beams, ambience; send the mood sentence and the light positions                                                                                                    |
| scenario-roblox-gameplay                 | collision groups, hitbox geometry, NPC navigation through the graybox                                                                                                         |
| scenario-roblox-tooling                  | Rojo projects carrying the file-only settings                                                                                                                                 |

## Current Roblox notes

- `Lighting.Technology` is superseded by `LightingStyle` (Soft or Realistic) and
  `PrioritizeLightingQuality`; scripts cannot read Technology.
- Script-refused, file-only (live): `StreamingTargetRadius` and the other streaming settings except
  `StreamingEnabled`, `Terrain.Decoration`, `GrassLength`, `MaterialService.<Material>Name`. Rojo
  7.7.1 writes them all (Lune read-back).
- A place built by Rojo starts with engine defaults: GlobalShadows off, environment scales 0, gray
  ambients, no Sky or Atmosphere (live).
- `GeometryService:SubtractAsync` and siblings replace `BasePart:SubtractAsync`; results come back
  unparented; a `CollisionFidelity` write reads back after the next yield (live).
- `ReadVoxelChannels` returns `Size` on the result table, `ReadVoxels` on the materials array
  (live).
- Terrain `Clouds` live under `Workspace.Terrain` and can be created by script (live).
- `ClockTime` does not advance by itself in a running game (live).

## References

- [`references/procedures.md`](references/procedures.md): P1 to P13, the code the live tests run,
  with results.
- [`references/critique.md`](references/critique.md): how to judge a capture; the findings from this
  skill's own captures.
- [`references/expert-notes.md`](references/expert-notes.md): the expert claims by source,
  agreements, disagreements and live corrections.
- [`references/gui-paths.md`](references/gui-paths.md): GUI-only tools, their code substitutes and
  menu paths.
- [`references/foliage.md`](references/foliage.md): scatter, leaf cards, collision, RenderFidelity
  and LevelOfDetail.
- [`references/verification.md`](references/verification.md): streaming test, overlays, texture and
  batching audit.
- [`references/sources.md`](references/sources.md): every source with its public URL.
- Kit: [`Graybox`](scripts/agentkit/environment/Graybox.luau),
  [`TerrainKit`](scripts/agentkit/environment/TerrainKit.luau),
  [`MaterialKit`](scripts/agentkit/environment/MaterialKit.luau),
  [`Looks`](scripts/agentkit/environment/Looks.luau),
  [`EnvAudit`](scripts/agentkit/environment/EnvAudit.luau),
  [`Scatter`](scripts/agentkit/environment/Scatter.luau),
